_comment: Auto-fetch sources for scripts/fetch-models.js. Each entry is one gateway catalog that is fetched and filtered for free ($0) models on every run. Order matters: earlier sources win when the same model id appears on several gateways (later ones are recorded as extra availability instead of duplicating rows). To add a gateway, add an entry — no code changes needed unless its catalog uses a new response shape, in which case add a normalizer to NORMALIZERS in scripts/fetch-models.js. Gateways that need an API key just to LIST models (e.g. TokenRouter) set api_key_env; export that env var (locally, or as a GitHub Actions secret) and their catalog is fetched automatically. Set "enabled": false to pause a source without deleting it.

_schema.name: Display name (used in logs, data/models.json 'sources', and as availability label)
_schema.enabled: Optional. Set false to skip this source without removing it
_schema.url: GET endpoint that returns the full model catalog as JSON
_schema.format: Response normalizer: 'openrouter' (OpenRouter-style pricing.prompt/completion; also matches the Kilo Gateway API), 'aihubmix' (numeric pricing.input/output, comma-string modalities), or 'openai' (plain /models list, free matched by name suffix)
_schema.id_prefix: Optional string prefixed to each model id to namespace it (e.g. 'aihubmix/')
_schema.provider: Optional. Fixed provider label for all models from this source; if omitted, the vendor is derived from the model id
_schema.source_url: Link written to the README 'Source' column. Use {id} to embed the model id, e.g. 'https://openrouter.ai/{id}'
_schema.rate_limit: Optional. Fixed rate-limit string for all models from this source (overrides the built-in per-vendor map)
_schema.free_filter: Optional. 'zero-pricing' | 'name-suffix' | 'zero-pricing-or-suffix' (default: 'zero-pricing-or-suffix' for openrouter/aihubmix catalogs, 'name-suffix' is available for plain OpenAI lists)
_schema.api_key_env: Optional name of an env var holding a Bearer token sent with the request
_schema.key_required: Optional. If true and api_key_env is unset, skip the source with a notice instead of fetching without auth

sources.name: Kilo Gateway
sources.rate_limit: 200 req/hour (anonymous, no auth) · higher for signed-in accounts
